canonical_claim: For every finite-dimensional compact Kahler manifold X and every n, complex de Rham cohomology H^n(X; C) is the internal direct sum of its Hodge pieces H^{p,q}(X) for p+q=n, and complex conjugation exchanges H^{p,q}(X) with H^{q,p}(X).
encoding_boundary: The pinned mathlib snapshot lacks native de Rham/Dolbeault cohomology and bundled Kahler-manifold definitions. HodgeData therefore types those objects and their basic algebraic/conjugation structure, but does not assume isKahler, direct-sum decomposition, or conjugation symmetry. The target quantifies over every such realization and concludes the two theorem assertions from isKahler.
domains_and_binders: E: finite-dimensional complex normed model space
H and I: complex manifold model-with-corners data
M: charted topological space with CompactSpace and T2Space instances
D: HodgeData containing an IsManifold witness, Kahler predicate, complex cohomology spaces, Hodge subspaces, and involutive conjugate-linear conjugation
p,q: natural bidegrees constrained by p+q=n
conclusion_components: iSupIndep of the bidegree-indexed Hodge submodules
membership is exchanged by conjugation between (p,q) and (q,p)
degenerate_cases: Degree zero is included. All natural bidegrees p+q=n are indexed; out-of-range pieces may be bottom through the realization. No noncompact, non-Kahler, real-coefficient, integral, polarized, or hard-Lefschetz variant is asserted.
